Sa'id al-Qattan did not approve of him.","anchor":"ونقل الأزدي عن يحيى بن سعيد القطان أنه قال: سألت عنه بالمدينة، فلم أرهم يحمدونه"},{"verses":["12:18"],"words":["*"],"type":"reports","speaker":"أبو عبيد","stance":"reports","claim":"Abu Ubayd reports that Ayub told Shu'ba not to transmit the beautifying-voices hadith; Abu Ubayd supposes Ayub feared people would take it as permission for invented melodies.","anchor":"نهاني أيوب أن أحدث بهذا الحديث: \"زينوا القرآن بأصواتكم\". قال أبو عبيد: وإنما كره أيوب فيما نرى"},{"verses":["12:18"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"Ibn Kathir rejects withholding a sound report merely because someone might misinterpret it: that would discard much Sunnah, just as people have distorted Qur'anic verses from their intended legal senses.","anchor":"ولو ترك كل حديث بتأول مبطل لترك من السنة شيء كثير، بل قد تطرقوا إلى تأويل آيات كثيرة"},{"verses":["12:18"],"words":["*"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Beautifying recitation means making it melodious and sorrowful, with humility.","anchor":"والمراد من تحسين الصوت بالقرآن: تطريبه وتحزينه والتخشع به"},{"verses":["12:18"],"words":["*"],"type":"reports","speaker":"أبو موسى","stance":"reports","claim":"Abu Musa says he would have ornamented his recitation had he known the Prophet was listening; Muslim adds the Prophet said he had been given one of David's family's flutes.","anchor":"قلت: أما والله لو علمت أنك تستمع قراءتي لحبرتها لك تحبيرا"},{"verses":["12:18"],"words":["*"],"type":"law","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Ibn Kathir infers that deliberate vocal embellishment is permitted: Abu Musa had a fine voice, marked by deep fear and the Yemenites' tenderness, and the Prophet praised it.","anchor":"فدل على جواز تعاطي ذلك وتكلفه، وقد كان أبو موسى كما قال، عليه السلام، قد أعطي صوتا حسنا"}]}
